record.original_question: Suppose T and S are cohomologous positive closed currents with T more singular than S. Determine whether their non-pluripolar self-products satisfy <T^n> <= <S^n>.

evidence.quote: Question 10 (Boucksom-Eyssidieux-Guedj-Zeriahi). Assume T ~ S with T more singular than S. Is it true that <T^n> <= <S^n> ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a compact Kähler manifold of complex dimension $n$, and let $T$ and $S$ be two cohomologous closed positive $(1,1)$-currents on $X$ (i.e. $\{T\} = \{S\}$ in $H^{1,1}(X,\mathbb{R})$). Write $T = \theta + dd^c \varphi$ and $S = \theta + dd^c \psi$ for a smooth representative $\theta$ and quasi-plurisubharmonic potentials $\varphi, \psi$. Recall that $T$ is said to be more singular than $S$ if $\varphi \le \psi + C$ for some constant $C$. For a closed positive $(1,1)$-current $R$ with potential $u$, let $\langle R^n \rangle$ denote the non-pluripolar self-product (the non-pluripolar Monge–Ampère measure of $u$ with respect to $\theta$), defined as the limit of $\mathbf{1}_{\{u > -k\}} (\theta + dd^c \max(u,-k))^n$ as $k \to \infty$.

Determine whether, under the above assumptions ($T$ cohomologous to $S$ and $T$ more singular than $S$), one always has the inequality
$$\int_X \langle T^n \rangle \;\le\; \int_X \langle S^n \rangle.$$
artifact.status_search_result: The mass monotonicity conjecture for non-pluripolar products (originally posed by Boucksom–Eyssidieux–Guedj–Zeriahi) was established by Witt Nyström, and further developed in work of Darvas–Di Nezza–Lu, where the monotonicity property for the mass of non-pluripolar products on compact Kähler manifolds is proved. Subsequent work by Vu and others extended this to different cohomology classes.

status_evidence.title: Monotonicity of non-pluripolar products and complex Monge-Ampère equations with prescribed singularity
status_evidence.snippet: We establish the monotonicity property for the mass of non-pluripolar products on compact Kähler manifolds.
status_evidence.claim: The mass monotonicity conjecture for non-pluripolar self-products of cohomologous currents (with one more singular than the other) is proved.

status_evidence.title: Monotonicity of nonpluripolar products and complex Monge–Ampère equations with prescribed singularity
status_evidence.snippet: Published version (Analysis & PDE, 2018) of the monotonicity result for non-pluripolar products.
status_evidence.claim: Published, peer-reviewed resolution of the BEGZ mass monotonicity question.
